other_conditions: Students must be admitted to an approved master's, M.Phil, or Ph.D. program abroad.
Students must be admitted to a recognized university or institution abroad.
Students must obtain an education loan from a scheduled bank under the Indian Banks Association (IBA) Education Loan Scheme.
Applicants must apply for the scheme's benefits during their first year of study; applications received in the second year or later will not be accepted.
The payment of financial benefits may be linked to the student's Aadhaar number.
benefits_summary: Provides an interest subsidy on education loans for minority students pursuing master's, M.Phil or Ph.D. abroad, reducing the cost of overseas education.
